h1: Custom Safety Apparel for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom safety apparel in bulk for your team. High-visibility shirts, vests, and more. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Safety apparel isn't just about compliance—it's about making your team visible and your brand memorable. High-visibility colors like neon yellow and orange ensure workers are seen on job sites, while providing a canvas for your logo. Whether you need safety tees for a construction crew or reflective vests for event staff, custom safety apparel combines functionality with brand exposure. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a durable finish that lasts through tough conditions.
heroAltText: Custom safety apparel including high-visibility shirts and vests with reflective stripes for brand visibility
